content: Abimɛlɛkin ɡɔɔn biru, Tolɑ, Puɑn bii, Dodon debubu Isɑkɑrin bweseru sɔɔ u seewɑ u Isirelibɑ fɑɑbɑ kuɑ. Tolɑ wi, u rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Sɑmiriɔ Efɑrɑimun ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ.
Wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ itɑwɑ u Isirelibɑ kpɑrɑ. Yen biru u kpunɑ u ɡu. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikɑ Sɑmiri mi.
Tolɑn biru Yɑiri Gɑlɑdiɡiiwɑ u Isirelibɑ kpɑrɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ yiru.
Bibu tɛnɑ u mɔ, ben bɑɑwure kɑ win kɛtɛku. Wusu tɛnɑ bɑ mɑɑ mɔ si bɑ rɑ soku Yɑirin bɑru kpɑɑnu. Su wɑ̃ɑwɑ Gɑlɑdiɔ.
Yen biru Yɑiri u kpunɑ u ɡu mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ Kɑmɔɔwɔ.
Isirelibɑ
bɑ kpɑm bũu sɑ̃ɑru wɔri

Yenibɑn biru Isirelibɑ bɑ kpɑm kuɑ ye yɑǹ Yinni Gusunɔ dore. Bɑ dɑ bɑ bũu tɔn durɔ be bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑɑlibɑ kɑ bũu tɔn kurɔ be bɑ mɔ̀ Asitɑɑtebɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Bũu ni, nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ Siriɡibu kɑ Sidoniɡibu kɑ Amɔnibɑ kɑ Mɔɑbubɑ kɑ Filisitibɑn bũnu. Nɡe mɛyɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ kuɑ bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ deri, bɑǹ mɑɑ nùn sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Yerɑ win mɔru yɑ seewɑ u bu Filisiti be kɑ Amɔni be nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Mɑ bɑ Isireli be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Amɔrebɑn temɔ Gɑlɑdiɔ, Yuudɛnin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ mi nɔni sɔ̃ɔwɑ n kɑ kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ yɛndu yiru sɑri.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Amɔnibɑ bɑ mɑɑ Yuudɛnin dɑɑru tɔburɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Yudɑbɑ wɔri kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛbɑ kɑ Efɑrɑimubɑ. Mɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ nɔni sɔ̃ɔrɑ.
Yerɑ bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɔɔɡiru sue bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ nun torɑri sɑ durum kuɑ. Domi sɑ nun deri wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ bɛsɛn Yinni mɑ sɑ dɑ sɑ bũu ni bɑ mɔ̀ Bɑɑlibɑ sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, ye Eɡibitiɡibu kɑ Amɔrebɑ kɑ Amɔnibɑ kɑ Filisitibɑ,
kɑ Sidoniɡibu kɑ Amɑlɛkibɑ kɑ Mɑonibɑ bɑ rɑɑ bɛɛ tɑɑre i sɑ̃ɑ ben yobu, mɑ i mɑn nɔɔɡiru sue i fɑɑbɑ kɑnɑ, nɑǹ bɛɛ wurɑri ro? Nɑǹ bɛɛ wɔre ben nɔmɑn di?
Adɑmɑ wee, i mɑn deri i bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ. Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, nɑǹ mɑɑ bɛɛ somimɔ.
I doo i bũu ni i sɑ̃ɑmɔ mi fɑɑbɑ kɑnɑ nu bɛɛ wɔrɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑ ten min di.
Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ yɛ̃ mɑ sɑ nun torɑriwɑ, ɑ kɑ sun koowo nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ. Adɑmɑ ɑ ku de ɑ kun sun fɑɑbɑ kue ɡisɔ.
Yerɑ Isireli be, bɑ bũu ni wunɑ ben suunu sɔɔn di, bɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃wɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ u ben wɔnwɔndu wɑ, wɑhɑlɑ ye bɑ bu mɔ̀n sɔ̃.
Mɑ Amɔnibɑ bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ ben sɑnsɑni ɡirɑ Gɑlɑdiɔ. Yerɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ mɑɑ beɡiɑ ɡirɑ Misipɑɔ Gɑlɑdin tem mi.
Mɑ bɑ wesiɑnɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wɑrɑ u koo sun kpɑrɑ su kɑ Amɔnibɑ wɔri. Wi u kpĩɑ u kuɑ mɛ, yɛ̃rowɑ u koo ko bɛsɛ be sɑ wɑ̃ɑ Gɑlɑdi mini kpuron kpɑro.
